Compare groups at chosen ages with Kruskal-Wallis and Dunn tests

Source: R/desc.R
wgh_compare_groups.Rd

At each milestone age (taking visits within window years of it), tests whether var differs between groups and runs Dunn's pairwise tests with Holm correction.

Usage

wgh_compare_groups(
  x,
  var,
  group,
  ages = NULL,
  window = 0.5,
  by = NULL,
  p_adjust = "holm"
)

Arguments

x

Data.

var

Numeric outcome.

group

Grouping variable (for example a BMI category at an index age).

ages

Milestone ages.

window

Half-width of the age window in years.

by

Optional strata such as "sex".

p_adjust

Method passed to stats::p.adjust().

Value

A list with overall (Kruskal-Wallis) and pairwise (Dunn).

Examples

cl <- wgh_classify(growdat)
cmp <- wgh_compare_groups(cl, "haz", "bmi_status", ages = c(8, 12), by = "sex")
cmp$overall
